 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 15:12 IST CBSE date sheet 2027 out soon CBSE Datesheet 2027: The Central Board of Secondary Education is expected to release the CBSE date sheet 2027 Class 10, 12 very soon on the official website- cbse.gov.in. The board will conduct the CBSE Class 10, 12 board examinations between February and April 2027.
 Every year, CBSE releases the Class 10 and Class 12 Board Examination Timetable PDF between October and December. This provides students with roughly 2 to 3 months of time to prepare for the theory and practical exams as per the subject-wise schedule.
 CBSE board exams are usually conducted in the morning session from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm across all designated centres. For exam subjects with just two hours, the exam is held from 10:30 am to 12:30 pm. 
 The timing and duration of the exam will be mentioned clearly in the CBSE timetable 2027 along with the date, day, subjects and guidelines for students.
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027 - Official websites 
 CBSE board issues CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 timetable in PDF format. To download the Timetable PDF for both classes, students must visit the official website cbse.gov.in . Students are advised to keep visiting the official website for the latest updates on the board exam timetable.
 CBSE Board Exam 2027: Practice sample papers 
 Ahead of CBSE Board Exam 2027, the board has issued sample papers for Class 10, 12 students to practice for better preparation. Students must note that CBSE sample papers will provide them with the exam pattern, marking scheme and the types of questions which can be asked under each section. This is not a copy of the question paper or a question bank. Students are advised to use the CBSE 10th and 12th sample papers only as practice and not make it their only prep material.

 CBSE 2027 Date Sheet Class 10/12 opens on screen
